candidates.snippet: South Africa, Morocco and Senegal are the Best National Football Teams in Africa, says Guinea's Coach, Paulo Duarte 🇵🇹. https://t.co/SbNyEqMSze
Morocco has the lowest poverty rate in Africa at 3.9%.

Ime Okon scored for South Africa 🇿🇦 in their 2-1 win over Guinea in the 2027 AFCON Qualifiers.

Babatunde Adepoju scored for Malawi 🇲🇼 in their 2-1 win over South Sudan.

Tosin Aiyegun scored for Benin 🇧🇯 in their 1-1 draw against Burkina Faso.

They are all of Nigerian descent.
